mods.name: Script Hook V
mods.author: Alexander Blade
mods.notes: The base every script mod runs on: lets the game load .asi plugins and scripts. Copies ScriptHookV.dll and dinput8.dll (the Legacy .asi loader) from the zip's bin folder, as its readme says ('Copy ScriptHookV.dll to the game's main folder, i.e. where GTA5.exe is located' and 'use the latest version that comes with this distrib (dinput8.dll)'). Not copied: xinput1_4.dll (the Enhanced loader), NativeTrainer.asi (Menyoo is the trainer) and args.txt (it switches BattlEye off; do that yourself in the Rockstar Games Launcher's settings for GTA V, as Menyoo's page asks). Delete an old dsound.dll ASI loader if you have one (its readme). Game builds: v3889.0's changelog covers every Legacy build up to 1.0.3889; dev-c.com only offers the newest release. Legacy builds per Script Hook V's changelog: 1.0.3442 (Mar 2025), 3504, 3521, 3570 (Money Fronts, Jun 2025), 3586, 3717 (A Safehouse in the Hills, Dec 2025), 3725, 3751 (Feb 2026), 3788 (Mar 2026) and 3889 (The Kortz Center Heist, Jul 2026; pnwparksfan's gameconfig release calls it 3899).

steps: Have an older ScriptHookVDotNet.asi next to GTA5.exe? Delete it: newer downloads call it ScriptHookVDotNet-Loader.asi, and two copies get in each other's way (the HUD's Legacy guide).

mods.notes: Runs the .NET script mods (the GTA VI HUD, Enable All Interiors and more); F4 opens its console. The GTA VI-Inspired HUD's Legacy guide: 'The HUD needs 3.7.0 nightly 193 or newer. The top release on the nightly page always is' and lists the 5 files Leonida copies. The gta5-mods page still shows 3.6.0-nightly (2022); the newest builds are only on the nightly GitHub releases (v3.7.0-nightly.206, 15 Nov 2026, checked 2026-11-25 on the author's page). Not Chiheb-Bacha's Script Hook V .NET Enhanced, although it also runs on Legacy: the HUD's Legacy guide uses this one, and Leonida rejects a zip without ScriptHookVDotNet-Loader.asi. Locked: ScriptTimeoutThreshold 15000 (instead of 5000) whenever Enable All Interiors is selected: its LoadMPMaps script otherwise gets terminated for freezing the game too long once the Showcase's map packs are in (seen in the real play test, 2026-11-25). Why ScriptTimeoutThreshold is locked to 15000 with Enable All Interiors: ScriptHookVDotNet.log on the owner's PC (1.0.1013.20, 2026-11-25) said '[ERROR] Blocking script! Script EnableAllinteriors.LoadMPMaps (file name: EnableAllinteriors.dll) was terminated because it caused the game to freeze too long' at the default 5000; with 15000 the play test passed. Its page gives no value.

ReloadKeyBinding.why: press it once after loading so Enable All Interiors loads the online maps; no key without it, so the scripts never restart by accident

ConsoleKeyBinding.why: no clash with the pack's other keys

ScriptTimeoutThreshold.why: gives Enable All Interiors time to load the online maps (the default 5 seconds stopped it)

mods.name: OpenIV (+ OpenIV.asi)
mods.author: OpenIV Team

steps: Download OpenIV from openiv.com and install it.
Open OpenIV, choose GTA V > Windows and point it at your game folder if it asks.
Tools > ASI Manager: click Install next to 'ASI Loader' and next to 'OpenIV.asi'. (If it says the ASI loader is already installed, that's Script Hook V's dinput8.dll: fine.)
OpenIV.asi makes the game load your changed files from the 'mods' folder, so the original game files are never changed. Every .oiv in Leonida's Legacy list goes to the 'mods folder'.

mods.notes: Loads modded game files from the mods folder, so the game's own files are never touched. OpenIV is free. Its ASI Manager and Package Installer are what the Legacy guides of the HUD, VisualV, Map Fixes and GTA V Remastered use (VisualV's page: 'Run OpenIV, click Tools -> ASI Manager and install ASI Loader and OpenIV.asi'). It's the Legacy counterpart of OpenRPF on Enhanced.
